  15|// reconcileAlreadyMergedFeatures finds FAILED parent tasks whose feature
  16|// branch is already an ancestor of the default branch (i.e. was merged
  17|// manually or by a supervisor). These tasks are transitioned directly to DONE
  18|// since their work is already on the default branch.
  19|func (o *Orchestrator) reconcileAlreadyMergedFeatures() (int, error) {
  20|	var tasks []model.Task
  21|	if err := o.db.Where(
  22|		"project_id = ? AND status = ? AND parent_task_id IS NULL AND worktree_branch != ''",
  23|		o.projectID, model.StatusFailed,
  24|	).Find(&tasks).Error; err != nil {
  25|		return 0, err
  26|	}
  27|
  28|	mainWorktree, err := o.worktree.MainWorktreePath()
  29|	if err != nil {
  30|		// No main worktree available (e.g. in tests) — skip this check.
  31|		return 0, nil
  32|	}
  33|
  34|	fixed := 0
  35|	for i := range tasks {
  36|		task := &tasks[i]
  37|
  38|		// Check if the feature branch tip is an ancestor of the default branch HEAD.
  39|		_, err := worktree.RunGit(
  40|			[]string{"merge-base", "--is-ancestor", task.WorktreeBranch, "HEAD"},
  41|			mainWorktree,
  42|		)
  43|		if err != nil {
  44|			continue // not merged yet
  45|		}
  46|
  47|		// Guard: if the task has subtasks but none completed, the feature
  48|		// branch was never successfully worked on. A branch created from
  49|		// HEAD with zero commits is trivially an ancestor — don't treat
  50|		// it as "already merged".
  51|		var totalSubs, doneSubs int64
  52|		o.db.Model(&model.Task{}).Where("parent_task_id = ?", task.ID).Count(&totalSubs)
  53|		if totalSubs > 0 {
  54|			o.db.Model(&model.Task{}).Where(
  55|				"parent_task_id = ? AND status = ?", task.ID, model.StatusDone,
  56|			).Count(&doneSubs)
  57|			if doneSubs == 0 {
  58|				continue // has subtasks but none completed — not actually merged
  59|			}
  60|		}
  61|
  62|		o.logger.Info("reconcile: failed task's feature branch already merged to default, transitioning to done",
  63|			"task_id", task.ID, "branch", task.WorktreeBranch)
  64|
  65|		// Bypass the state machine (failed -> done is not a valid transition)
  66|		// since the work is provably on the default branch.
  67|		now := time.Now()
  68|		event := &model.TaskEvent{
  69|			ID:        uuid.New(),
  70|			TaskID:    task.ID,
  71|			EventType: "status_change",
  72|			OldValue:  string(task.Status),
  73|			NewValue:  string(model.StatusDone),
  74|			Details:   model.JSONField{"reason": "reconcile-already-merged-to-default"},
  75|			Actor:     "orchestrator",
  76|			CreatedAt: now,
  77|		}
  78|		task.Status = model.StatusDone
  79|		task.UpdatedAt = now
  80|
  81|		if err := o.db.Save(task).Error; err != nil {
  82|			o.logger.Error("reconcile: save already-merged task", "task_id", task.ID, "error", err)
  83|			continue
  84|		}
  85|		if err := o.db.Create(event).Error; err != nil {
  86|			o.logger.Error("reconcile: save event for already-merged task", "task_id", task.ID, "error", err)
  87|			continue
  88|		}
  89|
  90|		// Clean up the feature worktree since the branch is merged.
  91|		featureName := strings.TrimPrefix(task.WorktreeBranch, "feature/")
  92|		if featureName != "" {
  93|			if err := o.worktree.RemoveFeature(featureName); err != nil {
  94|				o.logger.Warn("reconcile: cleanup merged feature worktree", "task_id", task.ID, "error", err)
  95|			}
  96|		}
  97|
  98|		o.emit("task_updated", task)
  99|		o.publishTaskTransition(task.ID.String(), string(model.StatusFailed), string(model.StatusDone), "reconcile: feature already merged to default")
 100|		fixed++
 101|	}
 102|	return fixed, nil

 105|// parentReconcilePolicy defines how to reconcile parent tasks in a specific
 106|// status whose subtasks are all done. This avoids duplicating the
 107|// query-filter-advance loop across reconcileCompletedParents and
 108|// reconcileFailedParents.
 109|type parentReconcilePolicy struct {
 110|	status  model.TaskStatus
 111|	logVerb string
 112|	// recover transitions the parent into a state where checkFeatureCompletion
 113|	// can act on it. Nil means the parent is already in the right state.
 114|	recover func(o *Orchestrator, parent *model.Task) error
 115|}
 116|
 117|func (o *Orchestrator) reconcileParentsByPolicy(p parentReconcilePolicy) (int, error) {
 118|	var parents []model.Task
 119|	if err := o.db.Where(
 120|		"project_id = ? AND status = ? AND parent_task_id IS NULL",
 121|		o.projectID, p.status,
 122|	).Find(&parents).Error; err != nil {
 123|		return 0, err
 124|	}
 125|
 126|	advanced := 0
 127|	for i := range parents {
 128|		parent := &parents[i]
 129|
 130|		var subtasks []model.Task
 131|		if err := o.db.Where("parent_task_id = ?", parent.ID).Find(&subtasks).Error; err != nil {
 132|			continue
 133|		}
 134|		if len(subtasks) == 0 {
 135|			continue
 136|		}
 137|
 138|		allDone := true
 139|		for _, sub := range subtasks {
 140|			if sub.Status != model.StatusDone {
 141|				allDone = false
 142|				break
 143|			}
 144|		}
 145|		if !allDone {
 146|			continue
 147|		}
 148|
 149|		if p.recover != nil {
 150|			if err := p.recover(o, parent); err != nil {
 151|				o.logger.Error("reconcile: recovery transition failed",
 152|					"task_id", parent.ID, "error", err)
 153|				continue
 154|			}
 155|		}
 156|
 157|		o.logger.Info("reconcile: all subtasks done, "+p.logVerb+" parent",
 158|			"task_id", parent.ID, "subtask_count", len(subtasks))
 159|
 160|		if err := o.checkFeatureCompletion(parent); err != nil {
 161|			o.logger.Error("reconcile: checkFeatureCompletion failed",
 162|				"task_id", parent.ID, "error", err)
 163|			continue
 164|		}
 165|		advanced++
 166|	}
 167|	return advanced, nil
 168|}

 170|// reconcileCompletedParents finds in_progress parent tasks whose subtasks are

 174|		status:  model.StatusInProgress,

 191|		return err
 192|	}
 193|	o.publishTaskTransition(parent.ID.String(), evt.OldValue, evt.NewValue, "reconcile: recovering failed parent")
 194|	return nil
